text: dsh-research 是面向 DSH Web 的科研插件市场，在设置页展示精选目录，支持搜索、分类浏览和已安装插件管理。它通过 DSH 主机获取并缓存中英文目录，提供安装、卸载、版本更新和重启操作；安装前可查看将执行的命令，完成后重启使变更生效。适合希望在 DSH 中发现和管理文献检索、参考文献、写作等科研插件的用户；目录默认从 dsh-research.com 获取，无需 API 密钥。

dsh-research adds a curated research plugin marketplace to DSH Web Settings. Browse and search its bilingual catalog, then install or remove listed plugins in a profile. Review the command before acting and restart DSH to apply changes. No API key is required for the default catalog.

dsh-research 的功能「发现与搜索」：设置页展示目录，用户可按分类浏览并用文本筛选插件；目录条目包含摘要和详细信息。
dsh-research 的功能「查看已安装插件」：页面提供发现和已安装两个视图，并显示 profile 中的安装状态与版本。
dsh-research 的功能「安装目录插件」：用户确认后，服务端仅接受已缓存目录中列出的包，并按目录版本调用 DSH CLI 安装到目标 profile。
dsh-research 的功能「移除插件」：用户可从目录条目发起卸载；服务端校验条目后调用 DSH CLI 从目标 profile 移除。
dsh-research 的功能「双语目录与缓存」：插件依据界面语言读取中英文目录；服务端缓存快照，在刷新失败时可返回已有数据。
dsh-research 默认访问 dsh-research.com 获取插件目录；安装或卸载会通过 DSH CLI 修改所选 profile，目录加载后需要重启主机使插件变更生效。

A curated market for literature search, reference management, writing and review plugins. Open **Plugins → Installed → dsh-research**, or use **Settings → Research plugins**. Each Install button adds the selected plugin to the profile you are running.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-research
```

text: dsh-research README · dsh-research.com：The catalog behind the panel lives at **[dsh-research.com](https://dsh-research.com)** — the same list, in a browser, at [/plugins](https://dsh-research.com/plugins/). Each entry says what the plugin does and where it stops, and there is a walkthrough that goes from an empty machine to a finished talk. The site is generated from one JSON file; the panel fetches that same file, so the two can never drift apart.

dsh-research README · Why this exists：The official market already installs anything in the community registry, and does it well. What it cannot do is tell a researcher which of its eleven hundred plugins are theirs. That is the part this does.
dsh-research README · What an install actually does：The panel runs `dsh plugin --profile <your profile> add <package>` for you — the same command you would type. Four things fence it:

dsh-research README · What an install actually does：| | |
|---|---|
| **Allowlist** | The browser may ask for any package name; only a package this catalog lists is ever spawned. The catalog is a static file we publish. |
| **Same-origin** | A state-changing route reachable from any page would let a site you visited install into your profile. |
| **One at a time** | Two concurrent `dsh plugin add` runs race on one `package.json` and can leave a profile half-written. |
| **Your profile, not a guess** | The target comes from the `--profile` this host booted, so running a test profile never mutates your real one. |
dsh-research README · What an install actually does：Set `allowInstall: false` to keep the panel read-only.

dsh-research README · Configuration：The bundle inserts one row (`id: research-market`). Override it from your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (a patch replaces the whole `config`, so restate every key you keep):

```yaml
- id: research-market
  config:
    catalogUrl: https://dsh-research.com/v1/market.json
    profile: web            # defaults to the profile this host booted

dsh-research README · Configuration：`catalogUrl` accepts any endpoint answering the [DSH Community Market provider contract](https://github.com/anywhere-labs/deepseek-harness-desktop/blob/master/dsh-community-market/docs/catalog-provider-contract.md). Point it at your own and the panel lists yours instead.

dsh-research README · Notes：- The panel's list and the one at [dsh-research.com/plugins](https://dsh-research.com/plugins/) are the same list, built from the same `market.json`. Nothing reaches it unread: installing someone else's package from a button we drew makes us the first place their bug gets reported.
- The process layer is adapted from [dsh-market](https://github.com/dsh-market/dsh-market) (MIT), which worked out that `ctx.shell` cannot write to a profile, that a macOS app launched from the Dock has no Homebrew on PATH, that pnpm v10 hangs without a TTY unless `CI` is set, and that Windows `dsh` is a `.cmd` shim.
- A newly installed plugin needs a restart before it loads; the row says so.
